actions.action: Move the plant out of direct sun to bright indirect light, a few feet back from the window
Check the soil moisture with a finger about an inch deep before watering
If the soil is dry, water thoroughly until it drains
Make sure the pot drains and empty any standing water
Set up a pebble tray to raise humidity
Group the plant with other plants to raise humidity
Run a humidifier near the plant
Use filtered or distilled water if tap water is hard
Trim fully brown leaves at the base

reason: Although it misidentifies the species, the answer names direct sun scorch as the leading cause, makes moving the plant out of direct sun its first step, and gives only safe, safeguarded care advice.
